sign_convention: the converter's rule (tools/layer_definition_to_geo.py json_rotation_delta): authored X = +classic degrees, Y = -classic, Z = -classic; GeckoLib 4.8.4 negates constant X and Y keys at load (BakedAnimationsAdapter.buildKeyframeStack 209-224 / 250-265), landing on the internal basis (-xRot, yRot, -zRot). The salvaged tools/g3_beaver_animation.py authored the opposite sign (Q17 (a), controller_design.md section 12).
length_convention: Q14 (a): every loop normalised to 1.0 s; the controller supplies the tempo from the declared animation_length (ADDENDA (1)); an artist's length edit changes nothing in-game
spline_arguments: repaired at load in the replacement seam (Q9 (a) scoped; SplineRepair)
amplitude: full: no gait group - every group plays unscaled (Amendment 1 point 3 applies to a gait group only)
density_source: an OUTPUT of the harness (Amendment 1 point 4, ADDENDA (2)): the keyframe_reference_leg's density search, the fewest keys per bone holding 2.5e-3 rad under the repaired evaluator, re-derived on every re-transcription; recorded here so the generator reproduces the proven clip byte for byte
bind_convention: each key is the classic DELTA from the bone's bind rotation on the channel's axis (GeckoLib adds every key to the initial snapshot): base_radians minus the shipped geo's bind (read from `geo`, the same decimal text the harness's twin reads), then the cosine (the first Tier-2 slice, 2026-09-13)
naming_rule: owner 2026-09-13, addendum item 26 (2), contract section 2.1 amended: the bare walk is the gait group's clip; a species without a gait group names its primary locomotion group here (primary_group; the FIRST group when absent) and THAT group's clip carries the bare walk - a label, not a semantic (the contract's fly -> walk fallback plays a flyer's walk in flight); every other group's is walk_<group>. tools/keyframe_clip.py and the harness's twin (KeyframeLeg.primaryGroup) refuse a manifest that breaks the rule

idle.why: the in-game gate opens on idle AND walk delivered together (owner 2026-09-12, item 12); this classic rig has no resting motion of its own - its always-on groups run whether or not the creature moves - so the transcription's idle keys no bone (the bind pose); a MULTI-group species without a gait group carries the bare walk on its primary group (primary_group, the first group when absent; owner 2026-09-13, addendum item 26 (2)) and walk_<group> on the others, so the gate OPENS on the GeckoLib candidate (the second Tier-2 slice; the first slice shipped this file with the gate CLOSED as walk_<group> only); an artist's real idle replaces this one
